_comment_observe_sight_range: THE DETACHED PARTY'S PER-TURN OBSERVATION RADIUS, AND IT IS THE EQUIPPED TIER - the party resolves it through `EquipmentStat::expedition_sight_range` off the kit it was launched with and its own wear, exactly the way a resident band's posted vantage resolves labor_config.json's `scout.vantage_range`. The BARE reading lives on the `wayfinding` item in equipment.json (unequipped 6.0), which is the flat radius this key used to be, so a party carrying no wayfinding gear observes exactly as far as it always did and only a kitted one sees further. PLAYTEST DIAL.

carry._comment_per_worker_carry: THE PACK - what one person carries, in food units, for EVERY carrier: a band splitting (its workers carry its goods and food), a band walking farther than it can ferry (it keeps what its workers carry and leaves the rest), and a party walking a trade shipment (cargo cap = party x this). Workers carry; dependants do not. 17 hands on the shipped 30-person band carry 17 x 8.0 = 136. A future carrier (a cart, a pack animal) attaches through the sim's per_worker_carry seam, so every carrier benefits at once. Must be > 0. PLAYTEST DIAL.
carry._comment_material_carry_weight: What one unit of a material costs in the pack, relative to one unit of food (1.0 = a hide and a meal take the same room), for every carrier. 0.0 is legal and means 'materials are weightless'. PLAYTEST DIAL.
carry._comment_fodder_carry_weight: What one unit of HAY costs in the pack, relative to one unit of food, for every carrier. PRICED IN TURNS OF KEEP, with food as the numeraire at 1.0: one worker's load of food is per_worker_carry / demographics_config consumption.per_capita_draw = 8.0 / 0.16 = 50 PERSON-TURNS. One animal's feed per turn is fauna_config's fodder_per_biomass x body_mass, and for the mid-sized pennable animals hay is historically for - crag_goat (0.05 x 6 = 0.30) and wild_sheep (0.05 x 5.6 = 0.28) - that averages ~0.29. So 8.0 / (50 x 0.29) = 0.55 (the pack cancels, so the ratio did not move with it), and 0.5 is still the clean dial beside it: a one-worker load is 53 GOAT-TURNS / 57 SHEEP-TURNS, the same order as food's 50 person-turns by construction. THE SPREAD ACROSS THE ROSTER IS HONEST AND INTENDED - the same bale is 1,026 turns of keep for a fowl and 2 turns for an aurochs, because that is what those animals eat. 0.0 is legal and means 'hay is weightless'. PLAYTEST DIAL.
carry._comment_item_carry_weight: What one whole ITEM unit costs in the pack, relative to one unit of food, for every carrier. A kit weighs the items it expands to (big_game = spears + sled = 2 at 1.0). A shipment carries no gear today. load = food + fodder_carry_weight x fodder + material_carry_weight x SUM(material units) + item_carry_weight x SUM(item units). 0.0 is legal and means 'gear is weightless'. PLAYTEST DIAL.

defection._comment_party_pull_threshold: THE PULL A DETACHED PARTY MUST ACCRUE BEFORE IT JOINS ANOTHER PEOPLE (docs/plan_band_fission.md Defection). Each turn its HOME band is below wellbeing_config migration.morale_threshold AND the party saw, on its own sweep this turn, a foreign band within migration.base_reach that passes the pull test and whose people keep Open Borders, it accrues migration_move_fraction(home morale); a turn without one resets it to 0. At rock-bottom home morale (rate 0.15) 0.3 is 2 turns in sight; at morale 0.2 (rate 0.03) it is 10. Too low: a party defects the turn it glimpses a camp. Too high: parties never sit near a camp long enough and scouts never defect. 0 is legal (defect on the first qualifying turn). PLAYTEST DIAL.
